info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Economic Capital Generation API
info.description: The Economic Capital Generation API facilitates the calculation and modeling of economic capital within banking operations. This endpoint allows users to submit data necessary for the computation of economic risk metrics, vital for financial decision-making and regulatory compliance. Financial analysts, risk managers, and compliance officers are typical consumers of this API, employing it to assess capital adequacy and liquidity under various scenarios. It plays a crucial role in understanding and managing a bank's financial stability and strategic planning.
